exercises.q: He was regarded as a hero.
exercises.why: **считался** — счита́ться (imperfective): to settle accounts (with), to consider, to take into consideration, to reckon (with); (impersonal, imperfective only) to be considered / reputed (someone), to be, to pass (for). Wiktionary: счита́ть + -ся.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Tom read the letter three times.
exercises.why: **перечитывал** — перечи́тывать (imperfective): to reread, to read again. Wiktionary: перечита́ть + -ывать.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: There are acknowledgements in every textbook.
exercises.why: **перечень** — пе́речень: list (register or roll of paper). Wiktionary: пере- + че́сть.
exercises.context: One family: which of its words fits?

exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: to take into account, to take into consideration, to appreciate (to be aware of)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: чита́льня — reading room; прочте́ние — reading, perusal; пе́речень — list (register or roll of paper); уче́сть — to take into account, to take into consideration, to appreciate (to be aware of).
